# Recorded failing and hanging tests.
#
# What it is for: a published documentation claim may not name a test on this list, because a
# proof that does not pass proves nothing. It is NOT a live exclusion list — nothing here is
# skipped on account of being listed, and adding a newly broken test instead of fixing it is not
# what this file is for. It shrinks in the same change that makes one of these pass; it grows only
# when the tree it is frozen against is measured again and something is genuinely still broken.
#
#
# Three fail outright:
cg_multi_chunk_import_applies_skills_and_carries_harness_report
ci_hardening::cargo_deny_check_runs_clean_against_current_main_crate_dep_graph_and_fails_loud_when_binary_absent
learning_sync_split::teaching_events_sync_tenant_wide_order_free_set_union
#
# Eleven hang rather than fail: they never return, so the runner stops them at its terminate-after.
# They carry #[ignore] because they hang under parallel load and stay listed here until the hang itself is fixed.
fabric_exactly_once::work_tables_are_append_only_no_update
fabric_exactly_once::worker_crash_mid_job_lease_expires_then_second_attempt_succeeds
fabric_receipt_honesty::executor_receipt_carries_real_tokens_and_elapsed_not_input_byte_length
fabric_retention::input_copies_deleted_on_executor_after_result_lands_plus_grace
fabric_status::attempt_ceiling_reached_marks_terminal_failed_visible_in_status
fabric_status::expired_lease_job_not_shown_as_running
fabric_status::receipt_origin_is_executor_not_submitter
fabric_status::remote_receipt_round_trips_unmangled
fabric_status::status_shows_state_executing_node_and_receipt
status_reports_whole_store_totals_on_a_context_larger_than_one_read
status_totals_stay_correct_and_bounded_on_a_store_no_single_read_can_cross
